name: Bonnie Day
statusNote: Shipped concept/pitch site, live. Dressed to the client's own literary branding, not the house style; every photo is explicitly captioned as a placeholder to be swapped for the business's own photography.
oneLiner: A rebuilt concept site for a Wolseley resto-café-bar, framed as a play in two acts — café by day, candlelit resto by night.
stack: genuine multi-page static site — separate HTML files per page

components.name: index.html
components.desc: Home: theatrical hero, Act I café / Act II resto split features, signature-dish grid, full-bleed room band, hours strip

components.name: menu.html
components.desc: Café/resto toggle tabs over dish listings

components.name: story.html
components.desc: Prose acts with pull-quotes, a dramatis-personae cast grid, and a dedication section

components.name: visit.html
components.desc: Hours table, contact/reservation panel, map band — the terminal reservation page

components.name: pitch.html
components.desc: The proposal; what's-included calls out the two-act framing and multi-page structure

dataFlow: True multi-page navigation: home links to menu, story, and visit pages via a persistent top nav plus in-content CTAs.
visit.html is the terminal reservation page — tel: click-to-call, no live booking form.
Images use an onerror JS fallback to hide broken images gracefully.
integrations: Unsplash stock photography, every image captioned as a placeholder
decisions: Literary, theatrical voice — stage-direction italics, a play in two acts, dramatis personae — matching the business's own branding conceit, not the house style.
The only one of the four pitch sites built as a genuine multi-page site.
Every photo flagged as a stand-in — the most explicit stock-photo honesty of the four.
Carries over an in-memoriam dedication from the real business's site — sensitive content preserved, not stripped.
